name: ctx-handoff
description: Hands off to a fresh conversation when context fills up, keeps the cache warm while you're away, and turns what you teach Claude into project notes

threshold.title: Handoff threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Hand off to a new conversation once context reaches this many tokens. On smaller windows, window_ratio of the window is used instead.

window_ratio.title: Handoff threshold on smaller windows
window_ratio.description: Fraction of the context window that triggers a handoff when the window is smaller than the threshold.

keep_cache_warm.title: Keep the cache warm while away
keep_cache_warm.description: Send a tiny request before the 1-hour conversation cache expires. Turn off on a 5-minute cache (API key, Bedrock, Vertex).

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes before keeping the cache warm
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without activity before each keep-warm request. The cache lasts 60 minutes.

max_refresh.title: Keep-warm requests per idle period
max_refresh.description: After this many, a handoff summary is saved instead.

min_tokens.title: Smallest conversation worth handling (tokens)
min_tokens.description: Below this, no cache keeping, away handoff or notes update.

project_notes.title: Project notes
project_notes.description: Turn what you correct or explain into notes for this project, loaded into new conversations.

notes_model.title: Model for project notes
notes_model.description: Model that updates project notes in the background, at low effort.

language.title: Message language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then your system language.
